data.name: Nuzha
data.gender_notes: Nuzha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nuzha is derived from the Arabic word 'nazhah' which means 'to make an excursion' or 'to go on a journey'. It signifies a journey or an outing. The name Nuzha carries the meaning “Journey, Excursion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nuzha usually hope their child will grow to embody journey, excursion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual journey towards self-discovery and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Nuzha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Journey, Excursion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuzha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Nuzha

This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing gratitude and appreciation for the blessings of life. It is associated with positive personality traits such as joy, serenity, and a deep connection to nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nuzha is a reflection of the adventurous and nomadic spirit found in many Islamic cultures. In the context of Islamic history, there have been numerous journeys and migrations that significantly shaped the Islamic world. For instance, the Prophet Muhammad himself led a migration from Mecca to Medina, known as the Hijra, which marked the beginning of the Islamic calendar and the establishment of the first Islamic state. Similarly, the Ottoman Turks embarked on many conquests, expanding the Islamic world into Europe and Asia. The name Nuzha thus embodies the spirit of adventure and exploration that has characterized Islamic history and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nuzha is rooted in the concept of spiritual journeys and the pilgrimage to Mecca, known as the Hajj. Just as Nuzha means 'to go on a journey', the Hajj is a journey of a different kind - a journey towards spiritual growth, self-reflection, and closeness to Allah. The Islamic tradition holds that performing the Hajj is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is a source of immense blessings and merit. Thus, the name Nuzha carries with it the profound spiritual meaning of a journey towards Allah and the pursuit of a deeper connection with the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nuzha is an Arabic name derived from the word "nazaha," meaning "to be pure, chaste, and free from impurities." It symbolizes a person who strives for inner and outer purity, leading a life in accordance with Islamic virtues.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.context: Nuzha was the name of a woman who was the mother of Harun al-Rashid, the fifth Abbasid caliph.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nuzha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
